chapters: Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baap gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu Jakob; gio ba' maa'n chɨbiapui bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu Rubeen gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Issakâr gu Sabuloon gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu Neptalii gu Gad gu Aser.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ moor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' gu Josee ka't gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Josee bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mui' jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix bhuup gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix búup kapbhai' jix vɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Ejipto cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee; gio ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix gɨ' jix kavɨk no'ch.
Na gu' jano' tu'ch mamatdagɨm na ba' bɨɨx na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bai'ñpu' bhɨɨ'ñdham gio bɨɨx bhaan no'ch gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon jɨ'dɨlh gu Pitom gu Raamses.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mui'; na ba' mi'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Egipkios jix duu tu juan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juantu'n bhi'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook yooxi' bɨx bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto baasɨ'n gu ebreas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sipra gu Puua.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk baasɨ'n gu ebreas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu mar; gio ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ mar u'vɨ jano' ba' gu tai.
Gu' gu' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duu na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' a'aalh.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto jix duu tɨɨt baasɨ'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' a'aalh.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon; na gu' gu u'vɨ gu ebreas cham na ja'p gu Egipkias; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix mui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix aa'ñdhix bɨx gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨx gu mar bɨx mar u'vɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu Lebii ka't jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam vaik masaa'n.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx gu vatop gu ñi'ook jix dhaas jugii'ñ gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba'.
Jano' ba' mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon jix dhaav jix duñia' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' suudai' jiim jix ñi' bhañ gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kupi'ook jix ñi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ua'tulhdhidha' jix duñia' jix aa'; jano' ba' a'aalh gu ebreos.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon; gio ba' tu jiim mɨmɨim tɨɨt gu ebreas na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon jix aa'; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt gu naan gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' namkidha'; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix duu.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Moisees bham; na gu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Moisees jix buus gu ja'tkam jix ñi'; gio ba' gu Egipkio maa'n gu ebreos gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñɨi'ñ cham soo'mchulhdhak gu Egipkio oo'.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu tanoolh buimgidhak ñɨi'ñ gook gu ebreos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tɨtmo.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' bhaan no'ch kooda' na ja'p gu Egipkio jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Faraoon dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kooda' gu Moisees; gu' gu Moisees vupui bhaan gu Faraoon jix daa gu oidha' gu Madiaan; mi' dhɨr jix daa ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Madiaan kɨɨv ma'nkam u'uuvɨ tɨɨtɨs jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' na ba' jix bhuup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i kakneer gu taat.
Gu' gu' bipia'dam tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix búup gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ragüel gu taat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨbiap gu ñi'ook jootom.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Egipkio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bipia'dam gio jix buusñi gu suudai' gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Ba' jix aa' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu chio'ñ mɨmɨim na ba' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees tɨ'ñcho gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix maa gu Moisees mar u'vɨ gu Seepora.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Gersom; na gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr mui'x gu tanoolh jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu jiim kuiñcha juantu'n tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juantu'n.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨ'ñcho ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees kakneer gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Madiaan kakneer oidha' jix gaki suudai' u'va gu oreb gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Angel gu Jawatan Dios mɨmɨim gu tai tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix ñi' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tai cham.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu jiim tu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha cham.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x; na gu' tɨɨt na gu' pai' tu' gu oidha' abhaar.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; na gu' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xoi'kam buupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto naak tu ñi'ook kuiñcha; na gu' no'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Egipkios jix buusñi mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix bhai' gu ux na tu ibai' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bii'm gu ñi'ook pai' gu Kananeo gu eteo gu Amorreo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' tɨbiap vupui bhaan tu' gio buupui gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Egipkios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Faraoon na ba' gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka jix duñia' tu' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Faraoon gu Ejipto gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' tu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat tu'; jano' ba' jix buusñi dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios bhaan dhi' gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' bhaan; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Moisees: «Aañ jir Dhi' na jix jai'ch bɨɨx tas».

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob tu' bhaan; jano' ba' dhi' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraa gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob jix ñi'ñ bham; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' buupui duñia' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu eteo gu Amorreo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' daraa gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu'; na ba' gu ñi'ook no'ch jano' gu bhóogɨt vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki na ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto cham kiicha' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Ejipto bɨɨx bɨx kɨɨ'p jano' ba' kiicha' tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu Egipkios na ba' na pai' dhuuk cham jix bhai'x.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' bhaan gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu'; jano' ba' cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha'; jano' ba' gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' gu novɨ baaso; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ baaso; jano' ba' na ja'p jix buusñi gu novɨ ka't na ja'p jabook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ baaso; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ baaso; jano' ba' baaso ka't na ja'p gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tu' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' dhi' gook buimɨk tu' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oidha'; gio ba' jix joi'ñ jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gɨ' suudai' jiim gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tu' cham jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dɨr tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam; na gu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka jix maa gu chin gu chio'ñ chɨkka jix duu jix bhai'x tu' bai'ñchu' cham jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' jix duñia' gu chin tu' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch ñiokda'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tɨip.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhaam bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' cham kakasnira' tu' xibhɨk gu Aaroon gu Lebita tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu chin gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' ka't tu' pai' gu chin tu' ka' na ba' pai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨɨx jix duu buimɨk.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu Moisees gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' gu Jetro; gio ba' tu jiim jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jetro jix aa' gu Moisees; jano' ba' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Madiaan; na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto na gu' jix duñia' jix koi bɨx koi'm.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu Faraoon bɨx kɨɨ'p gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham kiicha' tu' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' daipu' gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel gu mar maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu mar na ba' gu' cham jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' tu' kooda' gu mar maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus gu Jawatan Dios kooda'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Seepora gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu mar tɨɨt bham; gio ba' tu'r tu' saabum gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr saabum gu ɨ'ɨr kuiñcha matgilhdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx buimɨk ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon jum daa'ñ bɨx daraa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees tu' jix duu buimɨk vupui bhaan gu vupui gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' tɨiñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ka't buupui o'lhia.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr baap gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Faraoon gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu Israeel tu' cham kakasnira' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jano' gu bhóogɨt vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham bhaan no'ch bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu kuchii.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jano' jix jai' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Faraoon mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook duñia' va'k cham cham tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juantu'n bhaan na ba' cham gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon; mi' dhɨr tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook pai' bakia'; na cham tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ja'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na ja'p na pai' dhuuk.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam bɨɨx bɨx tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu duukam gɨɨ'bia' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano'; gio ba' cham maa'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Faraoon tu duukam gu noobh na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' dɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Faraoon na ba' ñiokda' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Faraoon; na gu' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Omnipotente gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon; gio ba' gu Jemuel gu Jamiin gu Oad gu Jakîn gu Soar gu Sauul gu mar gu Kananea; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu Lebii jix bɨɨx duu chamaam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Libni gu Simi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram tu' gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Koat jix bɨɨx duu chamaam gu ñi'ook vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Lebii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Amram jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Jokêbed; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu Amram jix bɨɨx duu chamaam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Isar; gio ba' gu Kora gu Nepeg gu Sitri.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel; gio ba' gu Misael gu Elsapaan gu Sitri.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Elisabet mar u'vɨ gu Aminadab gu ja'tkam gu Naasoon; gio ba' gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kora; gio ba' gu Assir gu Elkana gu Abiasap; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Koritas.
Jano' ba' gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Putiel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pinees; gio ba' dhi' ɨɨbhidham tattat gu Lebitas ja'tkam vaak.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' mii' dhɨr gu Aaroon mii' dhɨr gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bɨx tu'x tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Faraoon xibhɨk gu Aaroon ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' daipu' bɨx tu'x tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon xibhɨk tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon gu oidha' gu Ejipto buimɨk kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu Faraoon cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' tu' gu novɨ bhaan gu Ejipto jix buusñi chugi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu novɨ bhaan gu Ejipto jix buusñi gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duu.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu Aaroon jix bhai'x vaik na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Faraoon tu ñi'ook bham gu Mostrad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' daipu' gu Aaroon; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ vupui bhaan gu Faraoon na ba'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Faraoon tu' jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Faraoon tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gio gu Faraoon mamatdagɨm jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' jix duu gio jix duñia' gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' jix duñia' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulh; gu' gu Aaroon gu chio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon jix duñia' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto jix duu bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Faraoon gu vaak cham jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ dhi'.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx bɨx.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu suudai' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vaak tu duukam gu ja'tkam gɨ' suudai' jiim.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Faraoon a'ga jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ cham; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨɨx tu' naaka'n oo' gu oidha' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr bɨx oo' gu oidha' bɨx gu Ejipto.

Na gu' na gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu vaakax yooxi' kavaayo gu ñi'ook jix ai kakneer bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr jix koi bɨx gu vaakax gu Ejipto; gu' gu vaakax gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix koi maa'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Faraoon bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham ka't jix koi maa'n; gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham tu' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ maatai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Faraoon tu jiim gu Moisees bhaan gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax.
Na gu' nɨi'ñdha' cham gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Moisees kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' ka't nɨi'ñdha' bɨx gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham jix kai; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Lebaantate gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Faraoon; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam na ba'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix duñia' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bhaan tu duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam na ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' bɨx gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' jano' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ na ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ka' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu'r tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨxchu'x gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't jix duñia' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam na ba' cham jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu Ejipto dɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu vaakax bɨx yooxi'; na gu' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n bakia' yooxi' cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix dhaav bhaan koi.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu duukam gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax gu vaak.
Gu' gu' cham jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vaakax bhaan bɨx gu vaas yooxi' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tai jɨ'kchi bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' cham pai' dhuuk ka't bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto dɨr ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook naaka'n bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx ka't yooxi' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naaka'n gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaas yooxi' bɨx gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Goseen pai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p cham ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon bhañ tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' uañi'ñ dhi' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai' tu' gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' cham.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gamai' tu' kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' tu' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kai' vaas jix bɨɨx duu; na gu' kai' vaas ka't tu'.
Gu' gu' tiriik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix bɨɨx duu; na gu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨɨx gu Faraoon kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhuuk cham bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Faraoon dhuuk ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ba'k gu Faraoon; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tu duukam na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' buimɨk.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tu'x tu' gu Ejipto buimɨk tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' na ba' dhiñ tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Faraoon gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ebreos tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu Deja tu' gu ja'tkam na ba'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' gu xibh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu oidha' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'; gio ba' jugi gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jugi bɨx gu u'u gu i'bhɨ yooxi'.

Jano' ba' jix bhuup jix duñia' gu vaak bɨx tu duukam gu vaak bɨx gu Egipkios cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat tu' dɨr jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix buus bɨɨx gu Faraoon.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu duukam gu Faraoon gui'p; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Deja tu' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham ñɨidhat gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon suulh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨmɨim gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr chɨkka jix duñia' tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook a'aalh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kɨklhi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kakneer bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu'; na gu' tañia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook a'aalh; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' cham ka't; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' dhi'; jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Ejipto jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios gu jɨvɨl gu ux na tu ibai' bhaan bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu xibh gu jɨvɨl gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' va'k cham ka't gu ñi'ook nɨidhim tu' mi' dhɨr ɨlhdham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨx gu vaas gu oidha' bɨx gu i'bhɨ gu u'u ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook; na cham gu ñi'ook gu vaas gu u'u tu' gu vaas yooxi' bɨx pai' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix duu tɨɨt jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' soi'ñ jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ dhi' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi' koi'm.
Jano' ba' jix buus bɨɨx gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon; gio ba' cham bhañ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' ka't gu tukgam bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu novɨ bhaan gu tɨkɨr ka't gu tukgam vaik gu tanoolh bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ñi' tɨtmo tu' soo'mchulhdhak jix búup pai' vaik gu tanoolh; gu' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ko'kmarak gu tasi'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jix duu tɨɨt gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr kakneer; jano' ba' gio a'aalh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gio kapbhai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bɨɨx no'ch; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu juan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu juan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham jix duñia' tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; na gu' cham jix duñia' gu vupui na gu' gu tanoolh gu vupui koi.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; gio ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Faraoon bhaan gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr kiicha' tu'; jano' ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu ja'tkam maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa nɨidhidha' gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu Egipkios; gio ba' gio gu Moisees ka't gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vupui tu duukam gu Faraoon gu vupui gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ɨraab gu tukaa' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' koi bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto dɨr maa'nkam mar gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam atooxkor bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar ja'tkam na tu juan bhaan; gio ba' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto cham pai' dhuuk ka't tu' mɨɨjidha' ka't.
Gu' gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dɨr gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu vaakax tu' gagai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨn; na ba' dhiñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Egipkios gu Israelitas.

Jano' ba' jix dhaav tu' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix buus tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'; jano' ba' jix buus gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Faraoon cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' kɨɨ'p gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duu bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Faraoon; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon cham bhañ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu oidha' gu Ejipto bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam masaa'n; gio ba' ka't dhi' na ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n masaa'n oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bham; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n mar kaneer tattat mar kaneer ja'tkam vaak.

Gu' gu' tu' ja'tkam vaak ua'tulhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi mar kaneer jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu vaak bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' maa'n jurtu'nka' jugi jix duñia' bhaan mar kaneer.
Jano' ba' mar kaneer ka't cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ oi'ñga'; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim kakneer gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' nukadham bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook xib ja'k tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix duñia' jugi.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' jugi gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jugi.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tai; gio ba' mo'o bɨɨx tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jugi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr jugi; jano' ba' gu Paskua gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat gu vaak pai' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tanoolh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' maa'n gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't jabka' gu vaak; na gu' no'x dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm kɨɨv mii' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam abhaar kɨɨv gu tanoolh gui'x abhaar; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook bhɨɨya' jugi.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu tanoolh chugi'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na ba' dhi' gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu xumai jugi gu takarui' cham jabka' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh cham gu ñi'ook jabka' gu vaak na gu' no'x ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ja'p mii' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi; gio ba' bɨx jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx daraa gu Israeel; gio ba' jix buusñi jix bhɨɨ ali' karneer ja'tkam vaak maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gook bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' kiki'ñgob gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios; gio ba' na ja'p gu ɨ'ɨr gook gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr ki'ñgob cham kiicha' baakɨi gu vaak na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n na ja'p juraa'n tu ñi'ook dhi'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu Paskua gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto na pai' dhuuk naaka'n gu Egipkios jix duñia' baak gu vaak; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees gu Aaroon.

Jano' ba' ka't ɨraab gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto dɨr maa'nkam mar gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan atooxkor bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar ka't kuupa' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jix búup mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Faraoon bɨx tu duukam bɨx gu Egipkios; na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Ejipto na gu' cham ka't gu vaak pai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio kakneer na ja'p jix duñia' tu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gio tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Egipkios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu'ch koko'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam va'k jix duñia' gu' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa nɨidhidha' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Egipkios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Rameses gu Sukkot na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt cham a'aalh.
Jano' ba' gio jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maat chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' kakneer gu vaakax gu bhóogɨt mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jabka' jix buusñi gu Ejipto; na gu' cham ka't na gu' jix duñia' gu Egipkios cham jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook jugi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix daa gu Ejipto ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh moor bɨx chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu tukaa' nukadham gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' dhi' gu tukaa' nukadham gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' dhi' jir bɨx bhai' gu Paskua; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' jugi.
Gu' gu' bɨx tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix bhai'x cham jugi.
Jano' ba' gu vaak jugi cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu chuukug mai' gu vaak tu' o'o.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam mii' dhɨr bɨndak duñia' gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu chio'ñ jano' ba' duñia' ka't na ja'p gu oidha'; gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga ka't na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix duu.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx maa'nkam mar no'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; gio ba'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam; gio ba' xoi'kam chɨ'ñchoka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk; na ba' cham jugi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Abib.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu eteo gu Amorreo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo gu ñi'ook tattat tu' gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook jix duu dhi'.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' cham bɨndak tu' jabka' bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu mar bham; na pai' dhuuk dhi' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios jix duu na pai' dhuuk jix buusñi gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ja'p nɨi'ñchudat bhaan gu novɨ na ja'p chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan gu vupui na ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu chin; na gu' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook oidha' tas.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Kananeo na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook tu' tattat na pai' dhuuk tu' bhɨɨya' jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaakax; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mar kaneer; gio ba' tu' cham; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu xibh tu' tu ñi'ook gu mar bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' a'ga; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Faraoon cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios mu'aa gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx maa'nkam mar dɨr maa'nkam mar gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm maa'nkam mar gu vaakax; gio ba' dhi' kuiñcha tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx maa'nkam mar gu chio'ñ bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ja'p nɨi'ñchudat bhaan gu novɨ chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios cham gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu Pilisteos ka't mia'n; na gu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk cham gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨ'ñdham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio baidhak gu Moisees o'oo gu Josee ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ o'oo bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sukkot yooxi' gu Etam ba'k oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu tanoolh toov na ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tukaa' gu tai na ba'; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk ta'tak vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam toov gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa' gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' vupui bhaan gu Piairot tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Migdol gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan gu Baalsepoon; gio ba' vupui bhaan yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon na ba'; gio ba' jix duñia' tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr gu Egipkios tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jix duu.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon tu duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gu Israeel na ba' cham.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ baidhak gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Ejipto bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto chɨ'ɨɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios bɨɨx bɨx kavaayo gu Faraoon gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Piairot vupui bhaan gu Baalsepoon.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Faraoon ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vupui gu Egipkios aajidha' bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' cham ka't pai'm gu Ejipto jix buusñi na ba' vaak jodai oidha' jix gaki gu Por gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch jix buusñi gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' cham dhi' tu' a'aixkam gu Ejipto bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu juan gu Egipkios tutkɨ mai' tu juan gu Egipkios koi no'ch oidha' jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Egipkios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' buupui cham pai' dhuuk na ba' bɨɨx tas chɨgia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' kapbhai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu Egipkios na ba'; gio ba' tu' tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham kavaayo.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tas na jix gɨ' gu Faraoon gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan yooxi' gu Israeel jix ai'chdhix tu'; gio ba' toov vupui bhaan jix ai'chdhix jix dhaas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' gu Egipkios yooxi' gu Israeel; gio ba' ka't toov gu tukgam na ba' gu Israeel gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' cham pai' dhuuk.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ' suudai' gu jɨvɨl gu ux na tu ibai' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki ua'tulhdhidha' gu suudai' na ja'p vaak jodai kɨɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios baap bhaan bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx kavaayo gu Faraoon gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu xibh gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim yooxi' gu Egipkios dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai toov yooxi' gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ia'lhxichulh gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Egipkios gui'p; na gu' vupui bhaan gu Israeel na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Egipkios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' muuk gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' na ba' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bhaan gu Egipkios bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan kavaayo.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu kavɨk na pai' dhuuk; gio ba' gu Egipkios jix duñia' bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu Egipkios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' suulh gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon ka't kia'mi'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki ua'tulhdhidha' gu suudai' vaak jodai kɨɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Egipkios; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel jix ñi' gu Egipkios koko'kam jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Israeel mii' dhɨr jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Egipkios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jiiñ gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dhi' bhai' ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gui'p; na gu' jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' kavaayo.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Faraoon ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' chiñia' jix bɨɨx duu gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo.
Jano' ba' gɇ' suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu jodai jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk; gio ba' kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix búup bhaan tu'; gio ba' i'iich; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jajar.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gɇ' suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' bhaamki'ñdha'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' jix buusñi gu kuchii cham tu' duu tu' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl jix bhaan dhaas gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' na ja'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' chɨkka na ja'p tu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨ'n; gio ba' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch dhi' gu ja'tkam dodhia'; gio ba' bɨɨx gu kavɨk ba'bhak xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Palestina.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Edom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Moab gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim jix duñia' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu jodai; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ka't dhi' gu ja'tkam tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ux na tu ibai' gu kavɨk gu maa'nkar pai' gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xidhuu gu Jawatan jix duñia' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Na gu' na gu' gu Faraoon chɨbiapui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu gɨ' suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu jix gaki tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu Aaroon jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨx gu u'vɨ moor bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu gɨ' suudai' kavaayo.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo moor oidha' jix gaki gu Sur; gio ba' vaik gu tanoolh oidha' jix gaki cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mara cham i'i gu suudai' gu Mara na gu' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Mara.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix maa ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui naak gu ñi'ook nukadham bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk matgɨm ko'kdai' jix duñia' gu Egipkios tu'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sanador.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elim pai' ka't suudai' buusñi gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' ju'ñdharan gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Elim bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel suudai' u'va oidha' jix gaki cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Elim gu Sinaii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gook mi' dhɨr moor gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug na pai' dhuuk gu takarui'; na gu' jix duñia' jix buusñi dhi' oidha' jix gaki na ba' kooda' bhiogi' bɨx dhi'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Miren tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix duñia' na ba' gu tanoolh na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham.
Gu' gu' xijumai gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ka't gu tas jix duñia' gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu xumai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu xibh chɨgia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' naak vaak jodai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na no'ch gu ñi'ook gu'ch na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai bhaan no'ch.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu xumai gu chuukug na ba' jugi gu xibh gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak vaak jodai bɨɨx jix duñia' vaak jodai bhaan; na no'ch gu ñi'ook gu'ch vaak jodai cham bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na tu' naak vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' a'gi'ñchu' gu Aaroon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan oidha' jix gaki gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ toov.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' naak vaak jodai gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook xib ja'k tɨkɨr jugi gu chuukug gu xibh gu takarui' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xumai jix tɨ'ɨ novɨ maa'nkar gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' gu xibh jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix utu'ñ bhaan gu vupui oidha' jix gaki na ja'p bhaan gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gui'p; na gu' gu ñi'ook dhi' na gu' cham gu ñi'ook ka't; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa na ba' jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bhaan jugi; mi' dhɨr mo'o jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n na ba' vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook jix jai' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maa'n jurtu'nka' ka't jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' na ba' gu xibh.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu ñi'ook dhɨt na ba' gu tanoolh; gio ba' bhaam bhaan gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh maa'n bhaan ka't jugi; gio ba' gu tas.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gook gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'n; gio ba' bɨx chiñia' gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees jix duu maachim.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu xibh jix bhaan juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx na ba' gu xibh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh bhaan gu Moisees ka't jix duñia' cham tu' ka't suulhgidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook juanda' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham chɨɨmɨlhdhapu' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh; gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh juanda' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't dhɨt gu ja'tkam moor kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duu cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa juanda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix maa xijumai gu tanoolh gu takarui' na ba' gook gu tanoolh; gio ba' maa'n dhi' soo'mchulhdhak pai' kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix utu'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Israeel jup tɨɨt gu Manaa; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu kai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja na ja'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu' jugi oidha' jix gaki na pai' dhuuk tu' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ vaaso gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhuup vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' ka't na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Testimonio na ba' nukadham na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' koi'mɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm bɨɨx ka'm baap gu oidha'; gio ba' koi'mɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' pai' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Epa.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ta'tak oidha' jix gaki cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios yooxi' gu Repidim; gio ba' cham ka't gu suudai' na ba' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Moisees gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto na ba' kooda' gu ñi'ook no'ch gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ bɨndak daraa gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gio gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gɨ' suudai' jiim tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' vupui bhaan tu' bhaan jodai kavɨk gu oreb; gio ba' jodai kavɨk gu suudai' i'i gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees jix duu daraa gu Israeel.
Na gu' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Massa gu Meriba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch cham.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Amalek gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Israeel gu Repidim.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Josuee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix buus bɨɨx gu Amalek; mi' dhɨr gu xibh tu' dhi' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu Josuee na ja'p gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Amalek; gio ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ur jix tɨ'ɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh na jix bhai' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu novɨ gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu novɨ gu Amalek.

Jano' ba' gu noobh gu Moisees mi'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu jodai jix dhaas bɨtaa'n jix daa bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Aaroon gu ur gu noobh maa'n baasɨ'n; jano' ba' ka't gu noobh gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix dhaas gu tas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amalek gu ja'tkam gu kuchii.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ua'ñxidha' dhi' na ba' chɨ'ñchoka' u'uan tu' gu Josuee bɨx no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' gu Amalek bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jeobaa-nissi.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu novɨ bhaan atooxkor gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Amalek gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jetro jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Madiaan jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Moisees bɨɨx gu Israeel gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix buusñi gu Israeel gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees gu Seepora gu u'vɨ gu Moisees mi' dhɨr bhañ.
Jano' ba' gook gu ma'nkam; na gu' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gersom na gu' jix aa' gu Peregrino jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elieser na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki pai' ga'ra' yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' jir bɨx bhai' gu Jetro gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gook gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' tu'; gio ba' tɨkka maa'n gu ñi'ook mi'p tɨɨtɨs vaak zel.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu Egipkios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu Israeel bɨx tu jiim gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jetro bɨx xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ka't gu novɨ gu Egipkios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jetro; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ gu Faraoon jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' jano' kakasnira' gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jetro jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Aaroon bɨx daraa gu Israeel jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh jix daa gu Moisees gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam juruuñ vupui bhaan gu Moisees dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees bɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' duñia' tu' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan tu' dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' gu ja'tkam jupaabkamu'n tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk namki' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n tu'; gio ba' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees; gio ba' cham bhaan xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu' gio dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨndak; na gu' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr cham duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu bhóogɨt pai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ tu'r; gio ba' suulhgia' bhaan jix bhai'x bhaan chamaam bhaan mambhɨɨx bhaan mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix ali'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix duñia' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' tu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gio bhai'x i'ii'ñ pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jix kai gu Moisees gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' tu' jix duu bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu chio'ñ bɨx gu Israeel jix dhaas ɨɨbhidham bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan jix bhai'x bhaan chamaam bhaan mambhɨɨx bhaan mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu ñi'ook bɨx jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees jir bɨx bhai' ka't gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tɨɨtɨs oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Repidim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt dɨr gu kavɨk bham; mi' dhɨr daipu' gu vaak gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios gu ñi'ook bhaan gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan boopoya' chumñigam bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam; na gu' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam boopoya' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam abhaar; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Moisees jup tɨɨt daraa gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' gui'p; gio ba' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda'; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' toov na ba' gu ja'tkam tu' chɨɨdaim bɨndak gio na ba' tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu xibh gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jajannulhi'ñ.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu tanoolh vaik na gu' vaik gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaav gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu oidha' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' kɇkɇɇda' cham gu kavɨk tu' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr no'x kuichdha' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook koi.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't gu vaakax ka't gu chio'ñ cham ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr dhaibu jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu ja'tkam jix bhaan duu gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' vaik gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr cham gu u'vɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't vaik gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu xibh tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam toov bhaan gu kavɨk gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix buusñi vaak ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk.
Na gu' bɨx gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu tai; gio ba' kuubh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kuubh bɨx gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Moisees ua'rgidhimɨk gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam cham bhaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios na gu'.
Na gu' gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Sinaii na gu' tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Aaroon bɨndak; na gu' gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam cham bhaan gu oidha' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix dhaav gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' jix duu na jax chu'm tu' matgɨm na jax chu'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiix gu tɨkɨr tu' gu oidha' tu' gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' nɨidhat; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk jix bhai'x tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; na gu' cham maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix duu bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ tu' tu duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu vaakax tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx tu'x cham tu'x jai'ch jix utu'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' jix bhaan duu.
Jix bhaan ap tɨɨda' gu jum taat gio gu jum naan, na ap ba'x kɨɨ' oidha' bhaan gu oidha' na jum maa'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham koo'nda'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham bɨɨna'.
Jano' ba' cham tu ñi'ook bhaan tɨtmo ɨɨxi'ñdha' chuut.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tɨtmo cham gu u'vɨ tɨtmo tu' tu duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu vaakax tu' gu ñi'ook tu' tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiiñak gu kavɨk gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix dhaas.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu' cham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch na gu' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios na gu' choo'n na ba' cham.

Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' gu ñi'ook cham ka't ju'ñdharan.
