Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨya' jix maa gu u'vɨ bhɨɨya' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam cham namkidhat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maat ki'ñgob; gio ba' naak bɨɨx ka't tu duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios cham na ja'p jix buus tu duukam.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan cham jix bhɨɨ tɨɨmo' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' na pai' dhuuk.
Gu' gu' tu' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bhaan ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi tu' tɨi'chu' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' matgɨm dhi' vaik tu'x jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhidha' cham tuumiñ.
Na gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi.
Gu' gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu noobh jano' ba' tu' nɨi'ñchudat pai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' oi'ñdha' bhaan tɨtmo kooda' bɨɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bakia' gu noobh koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu taat gu naan koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhɨt oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook tɨtmo bɨɨx gu jodai bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham vaak jodai gu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' bhaan jano' ba' ka't naaka'n; gio ba' juruuñ.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai gu ñi'ook gu novɨ ka't.
Na gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gook cham ka't na gu' tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' tu' dhɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu' cham koi'm ka't jurtu'nka' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Gu' gu' tu' bhɨɨya' koi'm jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui taatam gu novɨ tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook koi'm.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu vupui tu duukam gu vupui gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' jix buusñi taatam tu duukam taatam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taatam kiicha' tu' namkidhat.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ vaak jodai gu vaakax ka't cham jugi gu chuukug; gu' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax ka't.
Gu' gu' tu' gu vaakax ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook cham bhɨɨya' kooda' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu vaakax ka't gio koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' maa'n gu ñi'ook ua'tulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar ka't mar u'vɨ jurtu'nka' dhi' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai gu Jawatan gu vaakax ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu vaakax gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ gu ñi'ook ka't jix koi ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaakax oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax tɨtmo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu ñi'ook tu jiim tuumiñ gio tu jiim jix koi.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax ka't gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook cham bhɨɨya' gu vaakax jix koi ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax tu' kaneer mii' dhɨr gu vaakax jixchamaam gu vaakax mii' dhɨr kaneer maakobh kakneer.
Jano' ba' tu' ɨxkum ua'tulhi'ñ gaagam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak ua'tulhi'ñ vaak jodai naaka'n cham ka't gu ñi'ook koi'm.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tas bhɨɨya' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' ɨxkum; mi' dhɨr tu' cham palhɨɨp ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gaagam bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ ka't gu vaakax buur tu' kaneer ko'iix.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' oidha' u'va gu vaakax gu oidha' tutkɨ pai' tutkɨ pai' u'va.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai bakia' jo'ii' ua'tulhi'ñ gɨ' kavɨk yooxi' gu tai.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtmo jix toja jodai nukadham ua'tulhi'ñ gu vaak mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu' ɨxkum bakia'.
Jano' ba' tu' ɨxkum cham bakia' jano' ba' gɨ'kora' vaak gu vaak ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu novɨ tɨtmo.

Na pai' dhuuk bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vaakax bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan kaneer bhaan tɨi'chu' bhaan bɨx gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk maa'n tu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' kuiñcha ɨlhdham vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' bhɨɨya' jix maa tɨtmo buur gu vaakax tu' kaneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n nukadham vaak jodai ua'tulhi'ñ baabuk cham jix ñi' soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu novɨ tɨtmo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham.
Gu' gu' tu' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ'kora' vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' chuut cham jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' tu' oi'ñdha' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax tɨtmo ua'tulhi'ñ muukix gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gɨ'kora' vaak ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' ka't ɨlhdham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jurtu'nka' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham kiicha' gu tai.
Jano' ba' no'x palhɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu vaakax.
Na maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix koi.
Na gu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na gu' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' matgɨm ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim tu' duuñ gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kooda' gu u'vɨ ka't dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tuumiñ gampai' bɨndak cham tu' bɨɨx na ja'p tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' tɨtmo gu tas jix maat.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr iiñat tɨi'chu' na ba' tu' koox; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk tu' duuñ tu' jano' ba' tu jiim na gu' jix duñia' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ux na tu ibai' tu'; gio ba' maa'n maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu vaakax kaneer; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu naan jix bhai'x gu tanoolh maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jɨɨgi'ñdham; gio ba' cham jugi gu chuukug yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gagai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨxi'ñdha'; gio ba' cham tu' bɨɨx jix bhai'x na ba' ñi'ookdham ɨɨxi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x na ba' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gampai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu vaakax bhaamki'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' bhaamki'ñ bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook kiicha' jano' ba' jix bhai'x cham uañi'ñ bɨɨx jix búup.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham koo'nda' jir bhai'; na gu' tu' cham jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' cham makia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na gu' gu ñi'ook bakia' gu i'ii'ñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ux na tu ibai'.
Gu' gu' kɨɨv kiicha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jugi gu vaakax yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jix duu oidha' u'va gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix duu kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu mar gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu ñi'ook boopoya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu takarui' cham jabka' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu Abib; na gu' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oraa' dharka' gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook yooxi'; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ɨ'ɨr gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu' gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' dharka' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham chiiw bɨɨx bii'm gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jootsa' gu Angel vupui bhaan tu' na ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' pai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham; na gu' cham uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Gu' gu' tu' tu'r gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx tu' tu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaamki'ñdha' obhɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Angel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu Amorreo gu eteo gu Pereseo gu Kananeo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo tu' cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu na ja'p xoi'kam; gio ba' va'k bɨx jix duñia' dhi'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' aa' gu takarui' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' bɨx ko'kdai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' mai' gu ebeo gu Kananeo gu eteo vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' oi'ñga' na gu' cham jix duñia' gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki bhaan tu' gu vaakax yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu oidha' gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dɨr gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Palestina dɨr oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim; na gu' gu noobh gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx tu' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham jix daa cham ka't tu' xoi'kam jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraa gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr dɨr.
Gu' gu' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham mia'n tu' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu ñi'ook gui'p; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees ua'na bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kɨkbo gu xibh jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tɨɨt gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bhañ biipibop gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios ali' vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ u'uan ñi'ook na jix bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga maatɨt gu ja'tkam; gio ba' chulhiiñchuda' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk ka't bɨtaa'n tɨɨt na ja'p jodai na jix tɨkɨr nɨidhim gu tɨkɨr na pai' dhuuk.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios koi'mɨk i'i.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu jodai ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook ua'nak na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Moisees gu Josuee gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios; gio ba' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' daraa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Aaroon gu ur bɨɨx bhaan; na palhɨɨp.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duu; gio ba' jix duu gio gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duu gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio jix duu gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon xibhɨk gu ma'nkam bɨɨx; gio ba' na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' ka't dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' cham jabka' gu takarui' cham jabka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' tu'x jix duu tiriik.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tuur gook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim kutun gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook jix duu bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mo'o bhaan abhaar.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu noobh gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan mo'o tuur.
Jano' ba' koo'nda' tuur vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr tuur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gio bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan gook bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai mai' yooxi' gu chuukug tuur; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' koo'nda' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bapaalh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar vaak na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh gu ñi'ook gu tai bhɨɨya'; na gu' cham jugi na gu' abhaar.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan tuur gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhaibu gu ñi'ook na ba' jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gook ali' karneer oi'ñga' gu tanoolh cham.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel pai' ka't bɨɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai bɨtaa'n kuruun gook gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx ka't baabuk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u gu Sittim jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan jix duñia' ju'ñdharan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut vupui bhaan iiñat bhaan chuut pai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Aaroon gu xibh; na pai' dhuuk tɨtɨɨya.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtɨɨya; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu tanoolh na jix bhai' tu' maa'nkar tai bhaan tu'; gio ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' bhaan a'aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook jix duñia' oi'ñga' bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook na ba'; gio ba' jix duñia' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook bhaan; mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' jix duñia' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk jix a'ga cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' maa'n no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jurtu'nka' xidhuu; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tuumiñ gu ñi'ook maa'n na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu noobh tɨɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ba'k vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' cham koi; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar tu' gu tai.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' abhaar gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim choi' gu ñi'ook ka't bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨichdhai bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' buusñi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu'x; gio ba' bɨx kuichdha' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam na ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' ka't bɨ'ñdhatu' abhaar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu chuukug gu chio'ñ cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' nɨidhim jurtu'nka'; gio ba' jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan jix duñia' jix xoi'kam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choi' nɨidhim bhaan gu tanoolh na jix bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook tu' kubhion; mi' dhɨr bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na jix bhai' abhaar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan chuut vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut pai' tu'; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu cham bhaan; gio ba' tu' ka't na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' no'x jix duñia' na ja'p na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios matda' bɨx.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai na ba' gu u'u; na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Aoliab gu mar gu Aisamak bopxi'ñ gu Dan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook matda' bɨx jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ na ba' xoi'kam bɨx tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut iiñat bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨichdhai na jix bhai' bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' buusñi.
Jano' ba' jajannulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' kutun na ba' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kutun gu ma'nkam na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas na jix bhaan; na gu' nɨi'ñchudat tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' dhiñ tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juanda' na gu' jix bhaan gu ñi'ook; na tɨɨda' koi; na gu' no'x jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu' gu tanoolh kɨɨv juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' no'x jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh juanda' koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' nukadham juanda' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat na ba' bɨɨx tas tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix utu'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chuut gu jodai ua'ñix bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' ñɨi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaav gu kavɨk jano' ba' gu Aaroon gui'p; gio ba' bamii' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan no'ch; na gu' dhi' gu Moisees mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto cham gu ñi'ook ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix ai'chdhix gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai ko'kmarak aichdhak gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhɨɨ gu noobh bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tuur; gio ba' jano' ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu Aaroon jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan tuur; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu xibh ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' jix daa gu ja'tkam jugi i'i jix búup.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ja'tkam jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu'.

Jano' ba' jootom jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tuur jix duñia' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Israeel dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' buupui dhi' gu ja'tkam tɨɨda' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook i'iich gu ja'tkam tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu kavɨk bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ñiokda' gu Egipkios bham; na ba' cham bhai' jix buusñi na ba' kooda' gu kakkavɨk na ba' bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' gu Bueelbete i'iich gu ñi'ook ɨlhdhai cham bhai' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel tu duukam gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu Yo gu kai' na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gu kai' bɨx dhi' gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' ka't duñia' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees jix dhaav gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu novɨ gook chuut ua'ñix gu ñi'ook; gio ba' baasɨ'n mi'p ua'ñix.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu'p ka't gu'p gu Jawatan Dios bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' tɨiñ gu Josuee tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk tu'; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' jix ñi' tuur daak gu Moisees gu noobh jix duñia' tɨɨt gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tuur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tai bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim oo' tu jiim bhaan gu suudai' jix maa i'i gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' jix maati' gu ja'tkam cham bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' gui'p; gio ba' gu asnos gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan no'ch dhi' gu Moisees gu chio'ñ jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto cham gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka juraa'n jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu tai jix buus dhi' tuur.
Na gu' ñɨi'ñ gu Moisees gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' na gu' gu Aaroon ka't jix duñia' na ba' xi'ɨraam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jix dhaas gu Moisees ki'ñgob vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' chɨkka gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jum daa'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu kuchii bhaan; jano' ba' ki'ñgob yooxi' maa'n xibhɨk jir bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii jix duu jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' maa'n tu' jix bhaan gu mar xibhɨk na ba' jix maa gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Moisees gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' uañi'ñ; gu' tu' jano' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' uañi'ñ na gu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' uañi'ñ tu' cham jano' u'uan ua'nak.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' u'uan.
Jano' ba' tu' jano' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n dhi' gu ja'tkam pai' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nobii'ñ vupui bhaan tu'; na gu tanoolh jix duñia' tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu ja'tkam na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tuur gu Aaroon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' gu ja'tkam jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob bham; mi' dhɨr gu kai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' nobii'ñ mai' gu Kananeo gu Amorreo gu eteo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bii'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na gu' gu ja'tkam cham ka't tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu ja'tkam dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' jano' gu oidha' tu' no'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' dɨr gu kavɨk gu oreb.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' yooxi' jix duñia' yooxi' jup tɨɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Testimonio; gio ba' ka't no'x gu Jawatan Dios busaak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut ka't mai' yooxi'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh na jix bhai' na pai' dhuuk busaak gu Moisees vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx gu ja'tkam jix búup ka't tɨɨt ki'ñgob vaak zel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees bɨɨx ka'm vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan toov tɨmñim ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ua'rgidhimɨk bɨɨx gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam toov ka't ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n ki'ñgob vaak zel jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' ua'rgidhimɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tu ñi'ook no'x duiñchu'; gio ba' yooxi'; gu' gu Josuee jix duñia' gu mar gu Nun cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Mira tu' tu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr jix buusñi dhi' gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' tu' cham jix duñia' chɨkka tɨip gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Yo tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gaagam gio nɨidhidha' gu vupui.
Na gu' jano' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu bhóogɨt na ba' tu' na gu' gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' gu vupui; gio ba' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu vupui cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix maati' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jiim tu' bɨɨx no'ch tu' gu ja'tkam tu'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu ñi'ook na gu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui tu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu vupui; na gu' cham gu chio'ñ ii'mdagaram.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' pai' ju'ñdharan tu' dhi' bhaan jodai kavɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' jodai kavɨk tu' bɨɨx gu novɨ bɨɨx ka'm ka't.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gu' cham gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku ua'na' bhaan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mi'p tumiiñku.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu xibh jix duñia' gu xibh gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bhaan gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bɨndak tu' oi'ñdha' bɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' tu' kakneer tu' gu vaakax vupui bhaan gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku; gio ba' jix búup gu xibh jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Sinaii na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gook gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaav toov juruuñ bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr na ba' daak jix gɨ' tu'r.
Na jix nukadham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ; na jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jano' gu Jawatan gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; na gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' uañi'ñ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vupui bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr kɨɨ'p cham jix duñia' bɨx gu oidha' tu' gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' vupui bhaan gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu eteo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' pai' baakɨi na gu' cham ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhi'.
Na gu' na gu' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Keloso gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu oidha'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨɨt jugi makgɨrxi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gio gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Abib; na gu' gu Abib gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaakax bɨx gu ñi'ook kaneer ua'tulhi'ñ gu chio'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mar kaneer gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' cham mo'o; mi' dhɨr bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam cham ka't jix bhai'x vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' oraa'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' tiriik; gio ba' gu ux na tu ibai' oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oi'ñga' ka't buupui bɨx gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Señoreador gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk tu' na ba' buupui vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vaik mui'kim oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu' gu tukaa' na ba' gu xibh gu maa'nkar gakdhi'ñchix.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' dharka' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham chiiw bii'm gu naan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' ua'ñxidha' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jurtu'nka' dhi' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak bɨɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' juruuñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; gio ba' cham jix jugi gu takarui' tu' jix i'i gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr ua'na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't jix dhaav gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii bɨɨx gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chuut gu novɨ tɨmñim gu kavɨk cham bhai'x gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n mi' dhɨr ka't bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Moisees gu vupui ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees; gio ba' gu Aaroon bɨx chiñia' gu ñi'ook suulh gu Moisees tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix aa'ñdhix bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook gu Moisees ñiokda' bɨɨx jix dhaas jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' ñiokda' bɨɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm busaak; gio ba' gamai' ua'rgidhimɨk bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vupui gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui bɨɨx ka'm ñiokda' bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' dhi' tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu' gu tanoolh kɨɨv ka't jix bhaan juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' no'x jix duñia' gu ñi'ook koi.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai bɨx gu tanoolh juanda'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio suudai' buusñi gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ux na tu ibai' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu maakobh bɨɨx maakobh gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees gu novɨ gu Itamar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur bopxi'ñ gu Judaa bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka't gu Aoliab gu mar gu Aisamak bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma'.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook xidhuu ka't jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar ka't cha'tmam gu ñi'ook bhaan xidhuu.
Jano' ba' jix toja jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix bhai'x jixchamaam bhaan xidhuu.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan xidhuu bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jiix jix bɨɨx duu vaik jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix toja jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook xidhuu gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cha'tmam gɨ' maa'nkar jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam jix bhaan dhaas.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu maa'nkar ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cha'tmam gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bɨx dhi' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx dhi' xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' xidhuu kutun na ba' gu Aaroon; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai ñakaabma' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix duñia' na ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai na jix tuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñakaabma' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhaan ka't jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix uam jodai jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai mia'n jix uam jodai bhiibgixim bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Moisees jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh gu jodai; gio ba' maa'n ka't jodai na jix vɨgɨ jodai na jix uam; mi' dhɨr dhi' maa'n.
Jano' ba' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai na jix chɨdɨ jodai na jix tɨkɨr jodai na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai na jix toja jodai na jix u'va.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namɨɨk; gio ba' mia'n jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu jodai jix duñia' jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' na ja'p bhiibgixim bɨɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook jix uam jodai; gio ba' gook jix uam jodai jix dhaas gook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook jix dhaas bhaan baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix dhaas gook jugii'ñ baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook jix uam jodai jix dhaas gook gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk na ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook cham; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx jodai na jix tuk.
Na gu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p baakux bɨɨx jannulhi'ñ na gu' cham.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio vaak ja'tkam jix uam jodai na jix bhai' vaak ja'tkam jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' vaak ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam xikoolh na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Aaroon na ba' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ'x bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk ñakaabma' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam abhaar jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook bhiibgixim gu Santidad gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook jodai na jix tuk na ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr jix duu.
Jano' ba' aichdhak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Moisees vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' iiñat tɨɨt jix duu gu chuukug iiñat tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam iiñat.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' tɨkiix.
Jano' ba' mɨichdhai na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtɨɨya bɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx; gio ba' suudai' buusñi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' ki'ñgob dhi' bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' xidhuu kutun na ba' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kutun gu ma'nkam na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n jix duu jix búup vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' gio mɨichdhai tɨtɨɨya.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai na ba' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx ka't jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' buusñi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon kutun gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu taat ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook oi'ñga' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees jix búup vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix dhaas tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix dhaas daam tu jiim; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix dhaas chuut gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu jiim iiñat bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix dhaas jix duñia' vaak zel jix bhaan dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu vaak na jix bhai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu vaak na jix bhai' mai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas mɨichdhai vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtɨɨya vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' makgɨrxi bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas suudai' buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' jix dhaas gu suudai' na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu noobh tɨɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na pai' dhuuk jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix dhaas gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' toov jix bhaan dhaas vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Na gu' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu Moisees baakɨi vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' toov ka't bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ga'ra' jix bhuup.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk toov gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx.
Gu' gu' tu' toov cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' toov gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tanoolh bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu tai ka't gu tukaa' ñiata bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
